Xapian 2.1.0, glass backend, compacted into one database after indexing.
Index is read from disk via pread through the page cache.
Single indexing thread (WritableDatabase has one writer).
BM25 with Xapian's defaults (k1=1, k2=0, k3=1, b=0.5, min_normlen=0.5).
Counts use check_at_least = doccount, so they are exact.
